track.title: Midnight Drive
track.line: Neon signs are melting on the glass
Engine hums a lullaby for the night
Empty roads and a radio glow
We chase the city lights until the morning light

track.title: Monsoon Mixtape
track.line: Rain on the window keeps the beat
Chai is steaming up the evening air
Old tapes spinning memories slow
Puddles dancing on the street

track.title: Golden Hour
track.line: Sunlight spills across the rooftop tiles
Everything glows a little brighter now
Laughing loud as the day slips by
Hold this gold before it fades away

track.title: Paper Planes
track.line: Fold the page and let it fly
Past the clouds and the highway signs
Nothing here can pull us down
We were born to chase the sky

track.title: Velvet Rain
track.line: Soft piano in a blue-lit room
Raindrops writing on the windowpane
Slow the clock and stay a while
Velvet whispers in the gloom

track.title: Concrete Rhythm
track.line: Beat on the pavement, hear it ring
Stories stacked like city blocks
Every corner got a verse to bring
Heartbeat steady, never stops
